note: item_group_db.yml as ItemGroupDatabase loads it: Clear applied, entries without a rate skipped except in All subgroups, amount capped to 1..30000, and empty subgroups removed. id is the group's IG_ constant. rAthena keeps subgroups and entries in unordered maps, so its iteration order depends on the C++ library; this file sorts them by number and index. duration is in minutes.
